# SCIRP Open Access

> > SCIRP is a multidisciplinary open access publishing platform hosting 200+ peer-reviewed journals across science, technology, medicine, and business with free manuscript submission and article access.

SCIRP (Scientific Research Publishing) operates a comprehensive open access publishing ecosystem enabling researchers to submit manuscripts, access peer-reviewed articles, and publish across diverse academic disciplines. The platform emphasizes research integrity, transparent peer-review processes, and global accessibility to scientific knowledge.

## Journal Discovery & Access

- [SCIRP Homepage](https://www.scirp.org): SCIRP main homepage for open access academic publishing platform
- [Journals by Subject](https://www.scirp.org/journal): Directory of 200+ journals organized by subject categories and disciplines
- [Journals by Title](https://www.scirp.org/journal/indexbytitle): Alphabetical index of all SCIRP journals with titles and subject classifications
- [Browse Articles](https://www.scirp.org/journal/articles): Browse and search published articles across SCIRP's journal collection
- [Recently Published Papers](https://www.scirp.org/journal/recentlypublishedpapers): Recently published papers across SCIRP's multidisciplinary journal collection
- [Journal Archives](https://www.scirp.org/journal/home): Journal archive repository with publication history and impact metrics
- [Biomedical & Life Sciences Journals](https://www.scirp.org/journal/categoryofjournal): Journal directory filtered by Biomedical & Life Sciences subject category

## Author Services & Submission

- [Author Services](https://www.scirp.org/author): Author services including manuscript submission, editing, and peer-review guidance
- [For Authors](https://www.scirp.org/aboutus/forauthors): Author guidelines, submission procedures, and publication resources for SCIRP
- [Open Access Journals](https://www.scirp.org/journal/openaccess): Open access publishing platform with paper submission and peer-review services
- [Journal Articles](https://www.scirp.org/journal/journalarticles): Open access journal articles with free download and citation capabilities
- [Paper Information](https://www.scirp.org/journal/paperinformation): Paper information and details for published articles in SCIRP journals

## Peer Review & Editorial

- [Peer-Review Resources](https://www.scirp.org/journal/peer-review): Peer-review process information and application to join SCIRP review team
- [Publication Ethics](https://www.scirp.org/publicationethics.html): SCIRP publication ethics policies, editorial guidelines, and research integrity standards

## Books & Special Issues

- [Open Access Books](https://www.scirp.org/book): SCIRP's open access book publishing center with academic book catalog
- [Special Issues](https://www.scirp.org/specialissues/specialissueslist): Directory of special journal issues with calls for papers and themes

## Organization & Support

- [About SCIRP](https://www.scirp.org/aboutus): About SCIRP: publisher profile, mission, and contact information
- [FAQ](https://www.scirp.org/aboutus/faq): Frequently asked questions about open access publishing, submission, and peer-review
- [News & Updates](https://www.scirp.org/news): News and updates about SCIRP, academic publishing, and research achievements
